summary: Optic lobe single-cell RNAseq across pupal development (Kurmangaliyev et al. 2020, Neuron), built from GEO GSE156455: the authors' cell metadata and raw 10x matrices for their main and separately clustered early (0-24h APF) datasets. Samples and Assays from GEO (7 female biological samples, 36 10x-library Assays) with FBdv stages and FBbt tissue, and FlyBase stocks linked. Two Clusterings (main, early) with one Cluster per author cluster: 196 main clusters (184 mapped to FBbt, 12 held) and 110 early clusters (48 mapped, 62 held), so 232 Clusters loaded. Summary expression for the loaded Clusters as CPM from the raw counts (686,568 cluster x gene rows with extent > 0.2; dataset total/filtered gene counts 15,751 / 7,473).

decisions.decision: Sample, Assay and Clustering layer built from GEO: one Assay per 10x library (one GSM per Chromium lane), FBdv stages and FBbt tissue per a curated timepoint map. Sample sex set to female, from the paper (not annotated in GEO).

Expression summary stats computed from the raw 10x matrix: CPM-normalised mean over expressing cells (level) and the fraction of expressing cells (extent), rows kept with extent > 0.2 (expression.tsv and GSE156455_expression.owl.gz). Total/filtered gene counts on each Cluster, and dataset-level total/filtered gene counts on the Dataset (union across clusters, matching the old repo's get_gene_counts).
FlyBase stock refs (FBst) for each sample resolved from FlyBase Chado and linked via BAO:0095000 'is derived from'; no free-text genotype slot.
Main-dataset clusters of author class C held (class undefined): 12 clusters.
Dataset carries site vfb:GEO (VFB Site node) with the GSE accession as the dbxref annotation.
Publication linked to the VFB :pub node FBrf0247594: first checked in the VFB curation KB by PMID (config fallback used, as it is not yet in the KB); now resolved from VFB production (pdb).

Regeneration under the general curation rules (one row per author cluster). The main dataset already had one row per author cluster (the 196 subtype populations of the authors' clustering; `type` only groups them), so its clusters, mappings and ids are unchanged.

Added the authors' separately clustered EARLY dataset (0-24h APF, GSE156455_metadata_early / matrix_early) as Clusters of the existing 'early' Clustering: 110 clusters labelled early_<cluster>. Main clusters relabelled main_<cluster>, with registry keys renamed so ids are unchanged.

Early-cluster mapping: 28 named clusters mapped by map-clusters-to-fbbt subagents to immature FBbt terms (e.g. immature lamina monopolar neuron L1); 20 numbered N/G clusters given stage-appropriate anchors (N: immature adult optic lobe neuron FBbt:00053539; G: glial cell FBbt:00005144, as FBbt has no immature optic-lobe glia term); 62 held (58 class x, unresolved; 4 class C).

Gene ids mapped to current FlyBase genes (FB2026_03, FlyBase Chado; gene_id_map.tsv via scripts/update_gene_ids.py): 86 secondary ids to the current gene (3 merges, counts summed per cell), 1 split id and 1 withdrawn id (snRNA:U3) dropped, symbols refreshed. Dataset total/filtered gene counts 15,751 / 7,473.

Clusters with no FBbt term (held) are no longer loaded: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason, but given no VFBseq id (previously minted ids removed from the registry, never reused), no Cluster entity and no expression rows. Their cells still count towards the Dataset's total/filtered gene counts, which measure what the experiment detected. Here 74 held clusters (12 main class C; 62 early: 58 class x, 4 class C) left out; expression 686,568 rows, dataset gene counts unchanged.
Assays named "<Sample>, 10x lane <n> of <N>" (paper Methods: 4 Chromium lanes per W1118 sample, 8 per DGRP sample; one GSM per lane), previously the accession or library id; ids unchanged.

Expression recomputed for main + early and compared with the previous main-only output.
checks.result: Main rows byte-identical; 901,382 rows total (before held clusters were dropped).
